name: evaluation-form-service
description: Plugins developed inside this repository and distributed together with it.

plugins.name: django-guardrails
plugins.description: Deterministic quality gates for Django/DRF repos: blocks writes to .env and secret-shaped literals, asks before shell commands that can destroy migrations, keeps the realtime layer out of services.py, auto-formats with black, and scaffolds tests proven to bite by an AST mutation check.
